title: Boy Jumping onto a Merry-Go-Round
body: A merry-go-round has a radius of $$2.0\, \text{m}$$ and a moment of inertia $$300$$ $$kg m^2$$. A boy of mass $$50\, \text{kg}$$ runs tangent to the rim at a speed of $$4.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$ and jumps on. The merry-go-round is initially at rest.
